name: Keep
info: <good>Marked KEEP</good>: the game asks before you drop, throw, disassemble or sell it, crafting does not use it unless you agree, and 'move all' leaves it with you.

name: Trade goods
info: Marked as trade goods: 'select all' in drop menus skips it.

name: Junk
info: <bad>Marked JUNK</bad>: sorted to the bottom; one key drops everything marked junk.
